title: HuC6280 block moves into a stack object get the block length as their destination offset
summary: Upstream MOSRegisterInfo::eliminateFrameIndex adds the immediate operand that follows a frame index as its displacement. The HuC6280 HuCMemcpy pseudo (src, dst, length, descending) has its length right after the destination frame index, so a block move into a stack object gets length instead of the operand's own offset: a 32-byte constant copied into a local array becomes `tii line,sstk+16,#16; tii line+16,sstk+16,#16`, which writes the first half over the second and leaves bytes 0-15 unset. Silent wrong code on moshuc6280 at -O2 on upstream main 06bc967d2668 (two corpus inputs of the default-mode set change, cardioid and mvscrl). The #321 split commit 'Select native 16-bit compares and fused branches' (#321-11) replaces the heuristic with a per-opcode rule for its own CmpBrAbsImm16 pseudo and fixes this as a side effect; that commit's plan claimed no default-mode effect. Upstream is not fixed. Round four checked whether the fix can be split out as a standalone upstream patch: it cannot be done cleanly. The HuC6280 effect is the same opcode-keyed displacement rule that #321-11 needs for its own CmpBrAbsImm16 pseudo; with the rule reverted, #321-11 still passes its lit suites (no test covers the rule) but miscompiles native compares on stack values under +mos-a16 (examples_65816_a16frameidx loads .Lcheck_sstk+4 instead of +0, and so on; docs/pr-preparations/2026-09-30/split-320-321/evidence/r4/huc-split-probe.txt). So the fix stays in #321-11, whose message states the HuC6280 effect.
attribution: Found by the third-round all-CPU default-mode gate of the #320/#321 split (review N17 follow-up), reduced and recorded: Claude Code 2.1.285 t4-opus-high agent a7633adfeee82a4f5, model Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), high reasoning effort (agent definition); session 310aee67-a99e-4b78-ba48-c560322fe80d (https://claude.ai/code/session_01Skyq488smgqkyyzHrcCX7F).
unknowns: Not run on hardware or an emulator; the wrong destination is read from the assembly.
Only HuCMemcpy was found besides CmpBrAbsImm16; other pseudos with an immediate after a frame index were not audited.
An ascending overlapping move `tii main.a+176,main.a+177,#5` appears in mvscrl on both upstream and the series; whether it is a memmove lowering defect was not traced.

related_changes: f2d65c23 (downstream #321 fix of the same heuristic)
prior_work.source_assessment: Upstream eliminateFrameIndex: `if (FIOperandNum + 1 < MI->getNumOperands() && MI->getOperand(FIOperandNum + 1).isImm()) Offset += imm; else Offset += getOffset()`. HuCMemcpy (MOSInstrLogical.td) lists src, dst, length, descending, so the dst frame index takes the length.
prior_work.binary_assessment: Upstream llc p-321-00 and the split's #321-10 emit the wrong destination for the reduced input; #321-11 and the series top emit the right one.
prior_work.decision: New defect: an upstream silent miscompile on HuC6280 that the #321 split fixes as a side effect; no earlier record or report.
